population.name: cwmai_evolutionary_dependency_management_v3_v4
population.description: Extends the existing dependency management system with proactive vulnerability scanning, automated remediation, and enhanced CI/CD integration using a risk-based scoring system. This version incorporates an error handling module to gracefully manage resolution failures and provides detailed rollback capabilities. It aims to minimize disruptions and improve application stability by proactively addressing dependency-related risks.

approach.vulnerability_scanning: Integrates with a vulnerability scanning tool (e.g., Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check) to proactively identify known vulnerabilities in project dependencies. Implements scheduled scans and trigger-based scans on dependency updates.
approach.risk_based_scoring: Introduces a risk-based scoring system that considers the severity of a vulnerability, the reachability of the vulnerable code in the application, and the criticality of the affected component. This scoring system prioritizes remediation efforts.
approach.automated_remediation: Automates the process of remediating vulnerabilities by suggesting dependency upgrades, applying patches (if available), or recommending alternative dependency choices. This includes automated pull request generation with recommended changes.
approach.ci_cd_integration: Tightens CI/CD integration by incorporating vulnerability checks into the build pipeline. Builds are automatically halted if critical vulnerabilities are detected based on the risk score threshold. Includes automated dependency analysis in each build and promotes 'shift-left' security practices.
approach.error_handling_module: Implements a dedicated error handling module to manage dependency resolution failures, vulnerability scan errors, and remediation failures. This module logs detailed error messages, retries operations with exponential backoff, and provides mechanisms for manual intervention when necessary. Notifications are sent for unrecoverable errors.
approach.rollback_capabilities: Provides comprehensive rollback capabilities that allow reverting to a previous, known-good state if a dependency update introduces instability or unexpected behavior. Rollback is triggered manually or automatically based on defined performance thresholds during testing after deployment.
approach.observability: Enhanced observability through detailed logging of dependency changes, vulnerability scan results, remediation actions, and associated risk scores. Provides dashboards and reports to track dependency health and identify potential risks.

metrics.mean_time_to_remediation: Measures the average time taken to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
metrics.vulnerability_density: Tracks the number of vulnerabilities per lines of code or number of dependencies.
metrics.build_failure_rate: Monitors the rate of build failures due to dependency-related issues.
metrics.dependency_age: Tracks the average age of dependencies used in the project.
metrics.error_handling_success_rate: Measures the percentage of dependency-related errors that are successfully handled by the error handling module.
metrics.rollback_frequency: Tracks the number of rollbacks triggered due to dependency updates.

integration_points.vulnerability_scanner: API integration with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check).
integration_points.package_manager: Integration with package managers (e.g., npm, Maven, pip) to manage dependencies.
integration_points.ci_cd_platform: Integration with CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI) to incorporate vulnerability checks into the build pipeline.
integration_points.repository_hosting_platform: Integration with repository hosting platforms (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for automated pull request generation and rollback management.
integration_points.monitoring_and_alerting: Integration with monitoring and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) to track dependency health and receive notifications for critical issues.
integration_points.logging: Centralized logging system for capturing dependency changes, vulnerability scan results, and remediation actions. Includes correlation IDs for tracking across systems.
integration_points.artifact_repository: Integration with artifact repositories (e.g., Nexus, Artifactory) to manage and track dependency versions.

population.name: CwmaiEvolutionaryDependencyManagementV4
population.description: An intelligent, evolutionary dependency management system that proactively identifies and addresses dependency-related risks across the software development lifecycle. It leverages AI-powered analysis and automated workflows to maintain a healthy, up-to-date, and secure dependency landscape, minimizing vulnerabilities and maximizing development efficiency. This version incorporates refined risk scoring and more robust CI/CD integration.
population.approach: This system employs a multi-faceted approach, blending static analysis, dynamic analysis, and runtime monitoring to provide a comprehensive view of dependency health. It uses a combination of heuristic algorithms, machine learning models (trained on vulnerability databases and code repositories), and graph theory to identify potential risks, such as outdated dependencies, known vulnerabilities, license conflicts, and circular dependencies.  The AI models learn from historical data and continuously adapt to new threats and evolving project requirements.  The system proactively suggests upgrades and remediation steps, automatically generating pull requests where appropriate. A core feature is continuous assessment, where dependency risk is re-evaluated with each code change and deployment. Furthermore, 'dependency aging scores' are introduced to highlight dependencies nearing end-of-life or becoming difficult to maintain. These scores are dynamically adjusted based on usage patterns and community support.

metrics.dependency_vulnerability_score: A composite score reflecting the overall risk associated with a project's dependencies, based on factors like vulnerability severity, exploitability, and age. Lower scores indicate better dependency health.
metrics.dependency_freshness: A measure of how up-to-date dependencies are, expressed as a percentage of dependencies that are at or near their latest versions.
metrics.mean_time_to_remediation: The average time taken to address identified dependency vulnerabilities.
metrics.license_compliance_rate: The percentage of dependencies with licenses that comply with project policies.
metrics.dependency_aging_score: A risk score based on predicted deprecation and maintainability, scaled from 0-100, 100 being very high risk.
metrics.cicd_integration_success_rate: The percentage of CI/CD pipelines that successfully complete dependency updates.
metrics.pull_request_acceptance_rate: The percentage of automatically generated pull requests for dependency updates that are accepted and merged.

integration_points.ci_cd: Seamless integration with popular CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to automatically scan dependencies, identify risks, and trigger remediation workflows during build and deployment pipelines. Includes automated pull request generation for dependency updates and rollback mechanisms in case of failures.  A key integration is automated build break if the 'dependency_vulnerability_score' exceeds a pre-defined threshold.
integration_points.code_repositories: Direct integration with code repositories (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) to analyze dependency graphs and track changes over time. Uses repository metadata to improve vulnerability scoring. Automated identification of 'abandoned' dependencies.
integration_points.vulnerability_databases: Regularly synchronizes with public and private vulnerability databases (e.g., NVD, Snyk, Sonatype OSS Index) to stay up-to-date on the latest threats.
integration_points.artifact_repositories: Integration with artifact repositories (e.g., Maven Central, npm Registry, PyPI) to track dependency versions, resolve transitive dependencies, and enforce version constraints.
integration_points.monitoring_systems: Integration with monitoring systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) to track dependency health metrics in real-time and trigger alerts when risks are detected. The 'dependency_aging_score' is a key signal for monitoring.
integration_points.issue_trackers: Integration with issue trackers (e.g., Jira, Asana) to automatically create and assign tasks for dependency remediation. Generates reports for governance and compliance audits.

population.name: intelligent_tool_allocation_router
population.description: Dynamically allocates user queries to specific, tool-generated workflows based on predicted success and resource availability, improving diversity in tool usage and system efficiency.
population.approach: Employ a multi-armed bandit algorithm to intelligently allocate queries across different tool workflows. The bandit algorithm learns which workflows are most effective for different query types, balancing exploration of new workflows with exploitation of known good ones. Diversity is encouraged by incentivizing the exploration of less frequently used tools. Resource allocation is factored in to prevent overload. A feedback loop, utilizing success/failure signals from each workflow, continuously refines the allocation strategy. Specific error patterns observed within each workflow are used to dynamically adjust the allocation probabilities, steering queries away from error-prone paths.

population.name: CwmaiEvolutionaryDependencyManagementV3Secured
population.description: An evolutionarily driven dependency management system enhancing security through reactive vulnerability assessment, LLM-powered anomaly detection in dependency graphs, and context-aware policy enforcement. Builds upon cwmai_evolutionary_dependency_management_v3_v3 by integrating real-time security analysis and intelligent policy adaptation.

approach.phase1: Evolutionary Fitness Function Enhancement: The fitness function now incorporates security metrics derived from vulnerability databases and dynamic analysis, prioritizing solutions with fewer vulnerabilities and better security profiles. The function rewards solutions with lower CVE scores and dependencies that have actively maintained security patches.
approach.phase2: Reactive Vulnerability Assessment (RV): A reactive tool, `ReactiveToolAssistedRecovery`, monitors newly discovered vulnerabilities related to project dependencies. When a vulnerability is detected, the system proactively explores alternative dependency configurations using genetic algorithms to identify less vulnerable replacements. This involves dynamically adjusting mutation and crossover operators to favor security-conscious dependency selection.
approach.phase3: LLM-Powered Anomaly Detection: An `LLMInferenceEngine` is integrated to analyze dependency graphs for unusual patterns or suspicious connections that might indicate supply chain attacks or compromised components. The LLM is trained on a vast dataset of known malicious dependency patterns and alerts the system to deviations from established norms.
approach.phase4: Context-Aware Policy Enforcement: Security policies are dynamically adjusted based on the risk profile of the application and the criticality of the dependencies. Policies may enforce stricter version constraints for high-risk components or trigger automatic remediation actions when vulnerabilities are detected. The system uses a policy engine that is informed by the LLM's anomaly detection output and the RV assessment.
approach.phase5: Security-Focused Mutation and Crossover: Mutation operators are biased toward replacing dependencies with more secure alternatives based on vulnerability scores and patch availability. Crossover operators prioritize solutions with better security profiles, promoting the exchange of security-relevant traits between individuals.  A logging mechanism is implemented to track all security-related events and decisions made by the system (`import:logging`).

metrics.policy_compliance_rate: Percentage of time the dependency graph adheres to defined security policies.
metrics.build_stability: Frequency of build failures due to dependency changes introduced by the system.
metrics.resource_utilization: CPU and Memory usage by each module of the system.

integration_points.dependency_graph_analyzers: Integration with dependency graph analyzers (e.g., dependency-check, snyk) to assess the security of individual dependencies.
integration_points.llm_inference_engine: Integration with `LLMInferenceEngine` for anomaly detection and policy enforcement suggestions.
integration_points.reactive_tool_assisted_recovery: Integration with `ReactiveToolAssistedRecovery` for automated vulnerability mitigation.
integration_points.build_systems: Integration with build systems (e.g., Maven, Gradle, npm) to automate dependency updates.
